To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the inclusion of demographic and personality information about individual workers in system performance prediction models is a valuable tool that can be used to improve model accuracy, but only when the modeler is aware of the limitations of the data used and the methodology used to incorporate the data in the model.

(1) personality and demographic information is important for predicting worker performance; (2) the way in which the information is used in modeling is also important; and (3) the use of personality and demographic information in modeling can have a significant impact on model validity.
the use of personality information in system simulation models can improve the accuracy of predicted system performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a model for the behavior of a team of individuals working in an industrial environment.
the development of a methodology for modeling workers and teams of workers in system simulation models.
developing a better understanding of how to model workers in system performance prediction models.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of personality and demographic data in system modeling is a valuable tool in predicting system performance.
the more information about the individual worker is included in the model, the more valid the model is.
the inclusion of worker demographic and personality data into system performance models is an effective and efficient approach to predicting system performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
personality and demographic information should be used in a way that is consistent with the underlying assumptions about how the system works.
we have demonstrated the importance of using the appropriate modeling methodology when modeling the performance of teams of workers.
personality and demographic information about workers can be used to improve system performance simulation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the inclusion of worker information can be a powerful tool for modeling system behavior and improving system performance prediction.
the way in which worker information is used in simulation modeling has a significant effect on the validity of the resulting system performance prediction.
the inclusion of personality data can significantly improve system performance prediction and, therefore, should be used in simulation modeling.
